text:
devon: FYI seeing sustained controller-manager reconcile spike in eu-central1 starting ~12:34 UTC. GPU provisioning backlog climbing, multiple Pods Pending, apiserver error rate creeping. anyone watching?

maria: i'm on it, pulling events. did we just test any autoscaler tweaks?

raj: i applied a brief ASG scaling policy change for a cost experiment earlier today, but no infra deploys now.

k8s-ops-bot: [alert] controller-manager leader change observed (old: controller-01 -> new: controller-03). reconcile_rate: 780 rps (1m avg).

sam: `kubectl get events --all-namespaces --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 40` shows repeated Node update events and kubelet issuing cordon/uncordon rapidly.

devon: controller-manager logs snippet:
```
I0901 12:34:35.123456 1 controller_manager.go:512] starting controller manager (leader-election: enabled)
I0901 12:34:35.223456 1 leaderelection.go:243] successfully acquired lease kube-system/controller-manager-controller-0
I0901 12:34:36.523456 1 sync.go:98] Reconciler "node" processing update for node gpu-az3-node-12
I0901 12:34:36.623456 1 sync.go:99] Reconciler "node" processing update for node gpu-az3-node-12
...repeated tens of times per second...
```

maria: sounds like a noisy node (kubelet flapping cordon state). that drives leader handoffs and lease churn which amplifies apiserver pressure.

oncall: i can fence the node and drain it. want me to proceed?

devon: yes cordon+drain gpu-az3-node-12. also bump controller-manager leader election leaseDuration to reduce flips while we stabilize.

raj: cordon/drain commands: `kubectl cordon gpu-az3-node-12 && kubectl drain gpu-az3-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`

sam: executing drain now. also patching controller-manager pod to increase CPU/memory and set leaseDuration 15s->30s.

k8s-ops-bot: patch applied to controller-manager deployment (image: redwood/controller-manager:v2.3.1-safety). rolling restart initiated.

maria: after drain event rate down ~85%. reconcile backlog (internal gauge) fell from ~420 -> ~60 in ~4 minutes. apiserver 5xxs dropping. GPU provisioning queue clearing.

devon: follow-ups: 1) check kubelet logs on the drained node for root cause (network MTU vs OOM), 2) revert ASG policy raj changed if it's contributing, 3) add short-term admission control on GPU create-rate to avoid re-triggering while leader stabilizes.

raj: will revert ASG back and run canary in staging.

sam: i'll open a runbook PR: steps for cordon/drain -> bump leaseDuration -> restart controller-manager -> monitor reconcile_rate & apiserver_5xx.

maria: kubelet logs indicate repeated health check failures to node-proxy; suspicious for MTU mismatch after an upstream peering change. forwarding to network team.

devon: good catch. marking incident mitigated. leaving RCA tasks with networking and autoscaler owners. :thumbsup:

oncall: incident note: mitigated by draining noisy node and stabilizing controller-manager (resource bump + leaseDuration). GPU provisioning backlog cleared. tracking RCA with networking/ASG owners.
